subject: general
question: Four numbers have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number that is different from the rest.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option 1) 7142 → Even number

Option 2) 4185 → Odd number

Option 3) 6183 → Odd number

Option 4) 8349 → Odd number

Thus, out of all the options, '7142' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer
